health_watch.boundary_rule: External provider, customer-impacting, destructive, browser, billing, deployment, legal/government, payout/refund, and credential actions remain boundaries unless an owner-approved non-browser receipt explicitly proves execution.

policy.evidence_rule: A check is marked live_action_observed only when an existing non-browser command actually executed and returned output; browser-disabled and provider-gated lanes are reported as boundaries, not proof.
